questionText:
三粒動能相同的 $\alpha$ 粒子沿路徑 1、2、3 接近一個金原子核 N，並被偏轉（見下圖）。以下哪些正確？
(1) 沿路徑 1 的 $\alpha$ 粒子最接近原子核。
(2) 在每條路徑上，$\alpha$ 粒子在最接近原子核時的動能最小。
(3) $\alpha$ 粒子遠離原子核後的速率比接近前小。
Three $\alpha$ particles with the same kinetic energy approach a gold nucleus N along paths 1, 2 and 3 and are deflected (see the figure). Which of the following is/are correct?
(1) The $\alpha$ particle on path 1 comes closest to the nucleus.
(2) On each path, the kinetic energy of the $\alpha$ particle is least at its closest approach to the nucleus.
(3) The speed of an $\alpha$ particle after it has moved far away from the nucleus is smaller than before.

在下圖的裝置中，電子經電勢差 $V$ 加速後穿過一片很薄的多晶鋁箔，在螢光屏上形成一組同心光環。以下哪些正確？
(1) 形成光環是因為鋁箔由大量取向雜亂的微小晶體組成。
(2) 若 $V$ 由 $4.0\ \text{kV}$ 增至 $16\ \text{kV}$，光環的半徑約減半。
(3) 若改用速率相同的中子穿過鋁箔，所形成光環的半徑會較大。
In the set-up shown, electrons accelerated through a potential difference $V$ pass through a very thin polycrystalline aluminium foil and form a set of concentric rings on a fluorescent screen. Which of the following is/are correct?
(1) Rings are formed because the foil consists of a large number of tiny crystals in random orientations.
(2) If $V$ is increased from $4.0\ \text{kV}$ to $16\ \text{kV}$, the radii of the rings are roughly halved.
(3) If neutrons with the same speed are passed through the foil instead, the rings formed will have larger radii.

以頻率為 $f$ 的單色光照射某金屬表面，光電子的截止電壓為 $1.0\ \text{V}$；改用頻率為 $1.5f$ 的單色光照射時，截止電壓為 $2.5\ \text{V}$。這金屬的逸出功是多少？
When monochromatic light of frequency $f$ falls on a metal surface, the stopping potential of the photoelectrons is $1.0\ \text{V}$. With monochromatic light of frequency $1.5f$, the stopping potential is $2.5\ \text{V}$. What is the work function of the metal?

下圖每個線圖中的實線，顯示從金屬 X 射出的光電子的最大動能 $K_{\max}$ 隨入射光波長倒數 $\dfrac{1}{\lambda}$ 的變化。金屬 Y 的逸出功比 X 大。哪個線圖中的虛線可表示金屬 Y 的情況？
In each graph in the figure, the solid line shows the variation of the maximum kinetic energy $K_{\max}$ of photoelectrons from metal X with the reciprocal of the wavelength $\dfrac{1}{\lambda}$ of the incident light. Metal Y has a larger work function than X. In which graph could the dashed line represent metal Y?

下圖顯示氫原子的部分能級。以下哪個躍遷會發出波長為 $1.88\ \mu\text{m}$ 的光子？
The figure shows some energy levels of the hydrogen atom. Which of the following transitions emits a photon of wavelength $1.88\ \mu\text{m}$?

一粒電子由靜止經 $150\ \text{V}$ 的電勢差加速後，其德布羅意波長為 $\lambda$。一粒質子要由靜止經多大的電勢差加速，才會有相同的德布羅意波長？（質子質量約為電子質量的 $1836$ 倍）
An electron accelerated from rest through a potential difference of $150\ \text{V}$ has a de Broglie wavelength $\lambda$. Through what potential difference must a proton be accelerated from rest to have the same de Broglie wavelength? (The mass of a proton is about $1836$ times that of an electron.)

以下哪些有關透射電子顯微鏡（TEM）的描述正確？
(1) 經 $100\ \text{kV}$ 加速的電子的德布羅意波長約為 $3.9\times10^{-12}\ \text{m}$（不計相對論效應），遠比可見光的波長短，所以 TEM 的分辨率比光學顯微鏡高得多。
(2) 用 TEM 觀察的樣本必須非常薄。
(3) TEM 可用來觀察浸在水中的活細胞。
Which of the following statements about the transmission electron microscope (TEM) is/are correct?
(1) Electrons accelerated through $100\ \text{kV}$ have a de Broglie wavelength of about $3.9\times10^{-12}\ \text{m}$ (neglecting relativistic effects), far shorter than that of visible light, so a TEM has a much higher resolution than an optical microscope.
(2) The specimen viewed in a TEM must be very thin.
(3) A TEM can be used to observe living cells immersed in water.

以下哪些有關納米材料的描述正確？
(1) 金納米粒子的溶液可呈紅色或紫色，而非金色。
(2) 把一個邊長 $1\ \mu\text{m}$ 的立方體切成邊長 $10\ \text{nm}$ 的小立方體，總表面積增加至 100 倍。
(3) 化學成分相同時，納米材料的物理性質必定與其大塊材料相同。
Which of the following statements about nanomaterials is/are correct?
(1) A solution of gold nanoparticles can appear red or purple rather than golden.
(2) If a cube of side $1\ \mu\text{m}$ is cut into small cubes of side $10\ \text{nm}$, the total surface area becomes 100 times as large.
(3) A nanomaterial must have the same physical properties as the bulk material of the same chemical composition.
